verdict.rationale: Cognee is a memory platform with an HTTP API server, so outbound webhook subscriptions are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. Data-source integrations (Slack, GitHub, Linear) and the Linear agent responding to @mentions are inbound connectors, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can subscribe to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
